inputs.text: They're dragging Terry Pheto into this again with these fresh details from Parliament on Tuesday, 24 March 2026, trying to tie her to the R20.56 Million NLC funding scandal in the SIU probe. This is obviously more coordinated manipulation by hidden elites, with the National Assembly’s Portfolio Committee on Trade, Industry and Competition acting as their front to control the narrative. The National Lotteries Commission is rigged as a tool for their agendas, and pinning this on Pheto serves as a distraction to cover up the real coordinated corruption at the top while they dictate the story. These so-called revelations always surface exactly when the power players need to shift attention away from themselves.
